page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. At the foot, the catchword sits at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: ( in Ecclesia constituta, & Judicio tua conso-
na ) ex professo difcrepantem : cuicunq; enim
Parti adhæseris, haud ita Illos demercberis qui
in Regiam Religionem ire prompti, quàm
Illos penitus inconciliabis, qui se spretos primùm
exi-stimabunt ut deinde opprimantur. Eam er-
go rationem instituas quæ manfuetudine &
charitate æquissimâ controversias (quæ ap-
parent, & offensas removeant, vel ita firmâ
& valida Potestate utaris, ut nulli Parti assentari
necesse habeas, nec ab ulla metuere. Si enim
aliqua Te huc impulerit necessitas ut preca-
riam ab illis opem exspectare oporteat, perii-
sti. Devorabit Columbam Serpens, nec minùs
ab ullis Iustitiæ, fidei, humanitatis speraveris,
quàm quos Pietas sua fecit Proditores. His
quicquid in rem suam fore putant, Dei Causa
est : sub vexillis pietatis producuntur omnes
vafræ Ambitionis artes maxima securitate &
plausu populi : Vox Iacobi auditur, sed Esavi
manus duras senties.
Nil mihi per annos complures levioris mo-
menti videbatur, quàm Factio Presbyteralis in
Anglia, ita publicè constitutis morem gesse-
runt, nec revera quoad speciem multi erant,
vel in Ecclesia aut Statu pollens factio : ut vero
Irâ & odiis divelli invicem coeperunt homines
& in partes secedere (non secus ac pravi solent
humores in partem malè affectam defluere,
unde fit inflammatio in Corpore) ita omnes
Novarum rerum avidi illi Parti potissimum
adhæserunt, quæ tunc maximè plausibili, &

page.notes: Running head: the Greek is set in capitals and I read it as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; the Λ and Σ are not fully clear at this scan resolution. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, as instructed. The page has no marginal notes. The text ends at "&" on the last full line, and "insigniori" is the catchword, so the sentence continues on the next page.
